interface.shortDescription: Framework-neutral E2E specification skill family (Gate A: help only)
interface.defaultPrompt: Run e2e-test-help to see current Gate A status and capabilities
interface.longDescription: This skill family targets E2E specification authoring, review, repair and proof reconciliation. Current Gate A status: independent repository skeleton only. The help service provides read-only diagnostic output. All other services return deterministic fail-closed responses (GATE_B_REQUIRED / NOT_IMPLEMENTED). No provider catalog is emitted. No registry binding exists. Artifact Contract and Family API are draft-only.
